messages.author: 3345fe7ecebfb837
messages.subject: measure canopy volume
parts:
Hello,

I noticed that FIELDimageR can estimate plant height using a pair of DSMs, with and without vegetation. Is it possible to use the same pair of DSMs to calculate canopy volume?

Thanks,
Brian

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: measure canopy volume
parts:
Yes ... In that case, you need to use "sum" instead "mean" in the function fieldInfo_extra()

Hope it helps,
Filipe
